description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Terminator Storm Force enhancement CORPOREUM RELIQUARY (WP-M2b): in your first Movement phase, the bearer's unit can make an ingress move. Fixture sm11e_m2b_marines_active (the Librarian in Terminator Armour carries it).
